subject: Request: Integrating Redwood for GitHub Actions — timezone & technical questions

From: Alice Moran <alice@openforge.dev>
To: priya_natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Jul 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Integrating Redwood with our GitHub Actions — request for 30m walkthrough

Hi Priya / Priyom,

I signed up on the self-serve flow earlier and started wiring Redwood into our CI (we're trying to use the API from a GitHub Action to do model-backed code insights). I ran into a couple of integration questions and would love a short technical walkthrough (30 minutes) to confirm best practices and permission requirements.

Quick context: OpenForge is a small maintainer org (repo: https://github.com/openforge/ci-actions). We want to:
- Use Redwood from a GitHub Action on PRs (ephemeral tokens / fine-grained permissions)
- Understand recommended webhook/auth flow for per-repo deployments
- Clarify SSO / SAML options for our contributors

I've attached a screenshot of the error we're seeing in the Action logs (openforge-integration-screenshot.png). Preferred times: weekday mornings in IST (around 09:00–11:00 IST) — our team is based in Mumbai. If mornings IST is tough, we can try afternoons UTC.

Attendees likely: me (Alice) and Sam Patel (our infra lead).

Available window: Aug 2–4 (flexible). Please let me know an available slot or share a Calendly link and we"ll pick one.

Thanks — excited to try Redwood, looks promising.

—
Alice Moran
OpenForge, Engineering
alice@openforge.dev
